findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (MR60PW-M) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J1

If radiated EMI is a concern on the cable, add a system-level common-mode choke or use shielded cable with chassis termination.

findings.title: Single ground via near ESD device D601
findings.description: D601 (esd_ic) has 1 ground via within 3mm. Multiple parallel vias reduce ground inductance. Two vias halve the inductance (~0.5nH → ~0.25nH).
findings.recommendation: Add a second ground via near D601 for lower inductance.
findings.summary: Single ground via near ESD device D601

findings.title: No ground via near ESD device D801
findings.description: D801 (esd_ic) has no ground stitching via within 3mm. The TVS ground pad inductance is the most critical parasitic in ESD protection — each nH adds ~37.5V overshoot during an 8kV strike.
findings.recommendation: Add multiple ground vias directly adjacent to D801 ground pad. Use fat, short traces to ground plane.
findings.summary: No ground via near ESD device D801

findings.title: U201 harmonics in 30-88 MHz band
findings.description: U201 (LMR36510FADDAR) switching at 0.5 MHz has 117 harmonics in the 30-88 MHz band (harmonics 60-176). Envelope rolloff at 32 MHz (-40 dB/decade above).
findings.recommendation: Minimize switching loop area for U201. Place input cap as close as possible. Consider spread-spectrum modulation if available.

findings.title: U201 harmonic envelope
findings.description: U201 (LMR36510FADDAR) switching at 0.50 MHz, duty ≈50%. Harmonic envelope: flat to 0.3 MHz, -20 dB/dec to 32 MHz, -40 dB/dec above. Harmonics extend into FCC test range starting at 60th harmonic.

findings.title: differential diff pair skew exceeds limit
findings.description: Differential pair SHUNT_W_SENSE_P/SHUNT_W_SENSE_N has 12.2mm length mismatch (66.2 ps skew). Exceeds differential limit of 50 ps by 32%.
findings.recommendation: Match trace lengths to within 25 ps (4.6mm). Use length-matched serpentine routing.
findings.summary: differential diff pair skew exceeds limit

findings.title: differential diff pair changes layers
findings.description: Net SHUNT_U_SENSE_P (part of differential diff pair) transitions across 2 layers (B.Cu, In2.Cu) with 2 via(s). Each layer transition is a potential DM-to-CM conversion point. Ensure stitching vias or decoupling caps at each transition.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias within 2× dielectric height of each signal via. Preferably route diff pairs on a single layer to avoid layer transitions entirely.

findings.title: 5V_BAT PDN anti-resonance peaks above relevant band
findings.description: U205 (MPM3620AGQV-Z) 5V_BAT rail (analytical): target impedance 0.374Ω (Vout=3.743V, 5% ripple, 0.5A transient). Peak(s) exceed target only above 200 MHz, outside the range board-level decoupling addresses: 208.9 MHz (0.42Ω). Decoupling: 2 caps (C219 22µF, C218 22µF).
findings.recommendation: No decoupling action needed for these peaks.
findings.summary: 5V_BAT PDN anti-resonance peaks above relevant band

findings.title: Large hot loop for U201
findings.description: U201 (LMR36510FADDAR) hot loop area ≈ 64mm² (triangle: C150 → U201 → L201). Recommended: <25mm² for low EMI.
findings.recommendation: Place C150, U201, and L201 in a tight triangle. Minimize trace length between them. Input cap should be adjacent to the IC with the inductor on the opposite side.
findings.summary: Large hot loop for U201
